svg.title: Four-Week Back-End Automation Rollout
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-back-end-automation-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Four-Week Back-End Automation Rollout; subtitle: Clean data, measure denials, pilot eligibility, then contract for outcomes; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Clean eligibility data; deliverable: COB error audit, since COB drives about half of eligibility errors; gate: No agent touches data that has not been cleaned; week: Week 2; title: Compute the matched denial rate; deliverable: Denials and payments mapped back to billing month, exposing gaps such as 15% denied against 7% recovered; gate: True net denial rate established before any vendor pitch; week: Week 3; title: Pilot an eligibility agent; deliverable: Cost-of-inaction case at $5 per manual check and $118 per denial reworked, against a 12% denial rate with 24% from eligibility; gate: Hard financial outcomes defined for skeptical CFOs; week: Week 4; title: Contract for KPIs and human sign-off; deliverable: Vendor contract with KPIs and a reporting feedback loop; humans review and sign agent-drafted appeals; gate: Vendor AI screened for repackaged RPA; caption: AI agents draft, verify, and route while humans review, sign, and handle exceptions.; assumptions note: The four-week sequence is an editorial ordering of reported gates; OpenBots claims ROI turns positive by month 3 to 4.; note: Attributed to OpenBots (ZpELLvKSrF8), Practical Data Solutions - Healthcare Analytics (4SW5Ihdk8ps), AGS Health (x0zeGvoXqsc), and HealthLeaders Media (BKBNIfZ081U).

text.title: Assumptions: The four-week sequence is an editorial ordering of reported gates; OpenBots claims ROI turns positive by month 3 to 4.
